translations.idiomatic: The matter is seen in the biography of Köke Temür.

sentences.zh: 會伯顏忽都皇后崩，十二月，中書省臣奏言，后宜正位中宮，帝不答。

translations.literal: When Empress Bayan Qudu died, in the twelfth month Secretariat ministers memorialized that the empress ought rightly to take the principal position in the inner palace; the emperor did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Bayan Qudu died, in the twelfth month Secretariat ministers memorialized that Gi ought rightly to take the principal position in the inner palace; the emperor did not reply.

sentences.zh: 又奏改資正院為崇政院，而中政院亦兼主之，帝乃授之冊寶，其冊文曰：「坤以承乾元，人道莫先於夫婦；

translations.literal: They again memorialized changing the Zizheng Court to the Chongzheng Court, and the Central Administration also jointly administering it; the emperor then invested her with patent and seal; the patent reads: "Kun thereby receives Qian's primal origin; the human way has nothing before the relation of husband and wife;
translations.idiomatic: They again memorialized changing the Zizheng Court to the Chongzheng Court, with the Central Administration also jointly administering it; the emperor then invested her with patent and seal; the patent reads: "Kun thereby receives Qian's primal origin; the human way has nothing before the relation of husband and wife;

sentences.zh: 后以母天下，王化實始於家邦。

translations.literal: the empress thereby mothers all under Heaven; royal transformation truly begins in family and state.
translations.idiomatic: the empress thereby mothers all under Heaven; royal transformation truly begins in family and state.

sentences.zh: 典禮之常，古今攸重。

translations.literal: The constant of ritual and canon—ancients and moderns alike hold it weighty.
translations.idiomatic: The constant of ritual and canon—ancients and moderns alike hold it weighty.

sentences.zh: 咨爾肅良合氏，篤生名族，來事朕躬。

translations.literal: We address you of the Sülügü clan, born of a famous clan, coming to serve our person.
translations.idiomatic: We address you of the Sülügü clan, born of a famous clan, coming to serve our person.

sentences.zh: 儆戒相成，每勤於夙夜；

translations.literal: Admonition and caution completing each other, you are diligent day and night;
translations.idiomatic: Admonition and caution completing each other, you are diligent day and night;

sentences.zh: 恭儉率下，多歷於歲年。

translations.literal: respectful and thrifty leading those below, passing through many years.
translations.idiomatic: respectful and thrifty in leading those below, passing through many years.

sentences.zh: 既發祥元子於儲闈，復流慶孫枝於甲觀。

translations.literal: Already sending forth auspicious omen of the eldest son in the Eastern Palace, again flowing blessing of grandson branches in the Jia Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Already sending forth the auspicious omen of the eldest son in the Eastern Palace, again flowing blessing of grandson branches in the Jia Hall.

sentences.zh: 眷若中宮之位，允宜淑配之賢。

translations.literal: Cherishing the position of the inner palace, it is fitting that the excellent mate be virtuous.
translations.idiomatic: Cherishing the position of the inner palace, the excellent mate is fittingly virtuous.

sentences.zh: 宗戚大臣，況僉言而敷請；

translations.literal: Imperial kin and great ministers—how much more when all speak and spread the request;
translations.idiomatic: Imperial kin and great ministers—all the more when all speak and spread the request;

sentences.zh: 掖庭諸禦，咸傾望以推尊。

translations.literal: the inner-palace attendants all lean in hope to push her honor.
translations.idiomatic: the inner-palace attendants all lean in hope to push her honor.

sentences.zh: 乃屢遜辭，尤可嘉尚。

translations.literal: Yet you repeatedly declined—especially to be praised and esteemed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet you repeatedly declined—especially to be praised and esteemed.

sentences.zh: 今遣攝太尉某持節授以玉冊玉寶，命爾為皇后。

translations.literal: Now we send the Acting Grand Marshal [name] bearing credentials to confer the jade patent and jade seal and command you as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Now we dispatch the Acting Grand Marshal [name] bearing credentials to confer the jade patent and jade seal and command you as empress.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 慎修壸政，益勉爾輔佐之心；

translations.literal: Carefully cultivate the rules of the inner quarter and further exert your heart of assistance;
translations.idiomatic: Carefully cultivate the rules of the inner quarter and further exert your heart of assistance;

sentences.zh: 昭嗣徽音，同保我延洪之福。

translations.literal: brighten and continue fine reputation, together preserving our extended great blessing.
translations.idiomatic: brighten and continue fine reputation, together preserving our extended great blessing.

sentences.zh: 其欽寵命，以衍壽祺。

translations.literal: Respectfully receive the favored command to extend long fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully receive the favored command to extend long fortune.

sentences.zh: 」二十八年，從帝北奔。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-eighth year she followed the emperor in flight north.
translations.idiomatic: " In 1368 she followed the emperor in flight to the north.
